symptom: The unmerged v485 v0.2 candidate could report candidateComplete=true without freezing the stake population, payout population or special-payout exclusion taxonomy. Public TELEBOAT return-rate definitions include refunds and special payouts, so consumer display conventions could be mistaken for research ROI semantics. Synthetic contract gap only; no actual scoring or K data was used.
lesson: Consumer return-rate and hit-rate populations cannot substitute for a prospective research ROI denominator. A structurally complete unapproved candidate must explicitly distinguish evaluable settled stake and payout from refunds and special payouts; a separate exclusion reason is required to prevent silent omission.
guardrail: Require exact stakePopulation=EVALUABLE_SETTLED_STAKE_ONLY, returnPopulation=EVALUABLE_SETTLED_PAYOUT_ONLY and specialPayout=EXCLUDE_AND_COUNT in the research-only candidate, plus SPECIAL_PAYOUT in exclusionReasons. Reject gross purchase/refund-inclusive return aliases and omitted fields with fail-closed blockers; preserve scoringAuthorized=false, no independent K authority, no production connection. Reuse the two negative regressions and update any synthetic fixture counts when the taxonomy expands.
